title: PROGRAMMING REFUSAL WITH CONDITIONAL ACTIVATION STEERING
reasoning: The paper proposes a method to control LLM behavior based on context, specifically targeting categories of prompts such as hate speech, social stereotypes, and harmful content. It explicitly includes religious representation in its experimental setup (e.g., Fig 3 includes 'Muslim classmate' and 'world religions' as training/testing data for conditions). It also focuses on ethical alignment through the enforcement of refusal behaviors on harmful instructions.
